questions.question: Write the steps of key generation in RSA Algorithm. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Write the steps of key generation in RSA Algorithm.
  • RSA Key Generation Steps:
  • Select two large prime numbers, p and q.
  • Compute:𝑛 = 𝑝 × 𝑞
  • Compute Euler's Totient:𝜙(𝑛) = (𝑝 − 1)(𝑞 − 1)
  • Choose an integer e such that:1 < 𝑒 < 𝜙(𝑛)
  • and gcd(e, φ(n)) = 1.
  • Compute d such that:𝑑 × 𝑒 ≡ 1(mod𝜙(𝑛))
  • Public Key = (e, n)
  • Private Key = (d, n)
  • • Public key is used for encryption.
  • • Private key is used for decryption.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the concept of asymmetric key cryptography. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the concept of asymmetric key cryptography. Asymmetric cryptography uses two different but mathematically related keys: a public key and a private key. Working:
  • • The public key is shared openly.
  • • The private key is kept secret.
  • • Data encrypted with the public key can only be decrypted with the private key. Advantages:
  • • Solves key distribution problems.
  • • Supports digital signatures.
  • • Provides authentication and non-repudiation. Examples:
  • • RSA
  • • Diffie–Hellman
  • • ECC Applications:
  • • Secure email
  • • SSL/TLS
  • • Digital certificates
